name: CIS Benchmark
description: Center for Internet Security Network Devices Benchmark for security configuration baselines.

controls.title: Disable Insecure Telnet Service
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, ensure cleartext Telnet service is disabled: remove 'service telnet' and enforce 'transport input ssh' on all management lines.

controls.title: Enforce SSH Protocol Version 2
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, enforce SSH version 2 and deprecate legacy SSHv1: execute 'ip ssh version 2' or protocol version v2.

controls.title: Disable Unencrypted HTTP Web Administration
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, disable plain HTTP web management: configure 'no ip http server' or disable web-management http.

controls.title: Enable HTTPS with TLS 1.2+ for Web Management
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, enable secure HTTPS access: configure 'ip http secure-server' and enforce TLS 1.2 or higher.

controls.title: Enforce Strong Non-Reversible Password Hashing
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, ensure passwords utilize strong cryptographic hashing: avoid reversible Type 7 or Type 0, and configure Type 9 (Scrypt), Type 8 (PBKDF2), or SHA-512.

controls.title: Enforce Minimum Password Length of 12+ Characters
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, enforce minimum credential complexity: configure 'security passwords min-length 12' or minimum-password-length 12.

controls.title: Enable Centralized AAA Authentication Framework
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, enable centralized authentication and authorization: configure 'aaa new-model' with RADIUS/TACACS+ servers.

controls.title: Configure Remote Syslog Logging Hosts
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, forward all security audit records to a centralized syslog server: configure 'logging host <SIEM-IP>'.

controls.title: Synchronize System Clocks with Authoritative NTP Servers
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, maintain synchronized time for audit accuracy: configure at least two reliable 'ntp server <IP>' sources.

controls.title: Remove Default SNMP Community Strings
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, remove default 'public' and 'private' SNMP community strings immediately, and transition to SNMPv3 with authPriv.

controls.title: Configure Legal Advisory Login Warning Banner
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, present an explicit legal warning banner prohibiting unauthorized access: configure 'banner motd' or login announcement message.

controls.title: Enforce Administrative Session Idle Timeout (<= 15m)
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, prevent unattended console hijacking: configure 'exec-timeout 10 0' or idle-timeout to 15 minutes or less.

controls.title: Implement Access Control Lists (ACLs) for Control Plane
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, restrict administrative access to authorized subnets: apply 'access-class' or firewall filters to management lines.

controls.title: Disable IP Source Routing
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, protect against spoofing and route redirection: execute 'no ip source-route'.
